hook: A bright high-energy interlayer exciton near 2.23 eV appears in few-layer WSe2
summary: Researchers found a narrow, bright high-energy interlayer exciton in few-layer WSe2 whose emission grows with thickness. Calculations point to mixing of intralayer and interlayer states as the cause. In a sliding-ferroelectric stack, its energy shifts with polarization, so moving domain walls can be tracked optically. The explanation of the brightening rests on calculations, and the device study covers one stack type.
title: Hybridization-brightened interlayer excitons in multilayer WSe2 controlled by sliding ferroelectricity
